summary: Updates RFC 3161 so a time-stamping authority can name its signing certificate using ESSCertIDv2, which allows hash functions other than SHA-1. It is a small proposed-standard change to support stronger hashes.

eli5.summary: It lets a time-stamp office name its ID card using a newer, stronger kind of fingerprint instead of only the old kind.

questions: time stamp protocol sha-256 certificate hash
